title: Cumberland Riverfront Home · Fire Pit · Sleeps 10
description:
Dinner on the screened porch while the General Jackson showboat paddles past below — that's this house. A Cumberland riverfront home in East Nashville with a fire pit in the terraced yard, a one-minute walk to Shelby Bottoms Greenway, and Riverside Village minutes away. Sleeps ten properly: three bedrooms with king beds, five beds total, two full baths. Full kitchen, keypad self check-in. Downtown is about fifteen minutes when you want it; the river is right there when you don't.

The space
This beautiful riverfront home in East Nashville offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and space. With 3 thoughtfully designed bedrooms and ample sleeping arrangements for up to 8 guests, it’s ideal for families, groups, and special getaways. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, cozy living room, and dining area that opens to serene river views. Step outside to a peaceful deck and enjoy your morning coffee or evening wine while watching the water flow by.

Other things to note
Smoking Fee - $250
